visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use auto margin for the last item
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The bar uses a fixed margin to push the button to the right, which breaks on other sizes. Use the auto margin on the button. The button must stay at the right end.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Inbox

solution.code: Inbox
solution.explanation: An auto margin takes all the free space on its side in a flex row, so the button always lands at the end, whatever the width. A fixed pixel margin is only right for one width.

checks.label: The title is on the left
The button is pushed to the right half
